study type: Retrospective analysis of historical control data
exposure: Spontaneous biological variation in unexposed control animals
outcome: Maternal reproductive findings (at terminal cesarean section)
Incidences of spontaneous fetal external anomalies
Incidences of spontaneous fetal visceral anomalies
Incidences of spontaneous fetal skeletal anomalies
cohort: Control Sprague-Dawley and Wistar Hannover rats from prenatal developmental toxicity studies conducted by 24 Japanese laboratories between 2011 and 2015.
finding: No noticeable inter-laboratory differences were observed in maternal reproductive data, while inter-laboratory variations in fetal anomaly incidences were largely attributed to differences in observation parameters, criteria, classification, and terminology.
